testPolicy.text: Standardized testing (either SAT or ACT) is an optional part of the admission application for first-year and transfer applicants, domestic and international; the ACT science section is also optional for the enhanced ACT. International applicants may be required to submit English proficiency results. Self-reported scores are accepted.

cost.totalIncludes: direct costs billed: tuition 75,330 + housing 10,980 + meals 9,340 + student activities fee 710 = comprehensive fee 96,360; indirect: personal expenses 1,800; travel varies. No books line is listed (CDS G5 reports books 0). 98,160 is the sum of listed items, not a published total. Student health insurance 3,627 (fall-billed annual premium, waivable with comparable coverage) and optional tuition insurance 530 are billed in addition, bringing the billed total on the fees page to 100,517.

aidPromise.text: Need-blind admission for all students, domestic and international; aid is need-based only (no merit scholarships) and Amherst is committed to meeting each student's entire calculated need. Amherst describes itself as a no-loan school (loans are optional); more than 80% of the Class of 2025 graduated with no student loan debt.

facts.text: Amherst is need-blind for international applicants too, yet 6,346 of its 15,819 fall 2025 applicants were international and only 92 of them were admitted.
Massachusetts residents filed 1,061 applications and received 123 admissions; out-of-state U.S. applicants filed 8,412 and received 1,007.
For fall 2025, 971 students applied Early Decision and 216 were admitted; Amherst says about 17 percent of admitted applicants come through ED.
Amherst says a year of education actually costs it about $140,000, more than the $96,360 comprehensive fee for 2026-27; endowment and gifts cover the gap.
The waiting list produced 44 admits for fall 2025 out of 740 students who accepted a place on it.

notes: amherst.edu returns HTTP 405 to curl and WebFetch; the CDS section PDFs (listed on https://www.amherst.edu/about/facts/common_data_sets/2025) and the admission/aid pages were opened in Chrome, so no PDF copy is saved in .cache-raw. C1 detail: 7,425 men + 8,375 women applied (total 15,819 includes students without gender data); 539 men + 682 women + 1 another gender admitted. The C9 question label in the PDF says 'Fall 2024' but section C is headed Fall 2025 and the file is the 2025-26 CDS. Number of students offered a waiting-list place is blank. CDS G1 (tuition 73,140, fees 690, food and housing 19,260) is 2025-26, with the 2026-27 'not available' box checked; cost uses the financial aid 2026-27 pages. ED deadline on the calendar page was read as November 9, 2026 from the first-year page; the CDS 2025-26 ED fields are hard to align (7-Nov / 15-Dec). No official fall 2026 counts found.
